note: Small (36-acre) NGPC recreation area on the Missouri River, ~4 mi east of Tekamah via County Road KL. Basic camping under cottonwoods around a gravel loop by the boat ramp; no electric or water. Vault toilet, picnic shelter, boat ramp and dock. --Claude
summary: Still NGPC (2025 grid row, Parks_Locations 'Active'/'Open', Park_Areas 2026), basic only, first-come. Fees 10/15 confirmed; fee note's online reservation fee removed. Facilities now sourced (vault toilet yes; water, showers, dump no). PIN MOVE ~3 km: stored point is in farm fields across the river in Iowa. Not waterfront kept. Phone added (flag). Note cleaned.
flags: PIN MOVE 41.83520,-96.07600 -> 41.83380,-96.11230 (elevation 314 -> 315 m, Open-Meteo DEM). The stored point is beside grain bins in crop fields ~2.8 km EAST of the Missouri River (the Iowa side). NGPC's Park_Areas polygon (41.8301-41.83664,-96.1144..-96.11072), Parks_Locations (41.83355,-96.11292), Google and RV Life all put the SRA on the Nebraska bank. Imagery shows the camp: a gravel teardrop loop with a vault toilet at ~41.8339,-96.1120, the boat ramp just south-east, and open mown ground with tables under cottonwoods along the west track and south of the loop; the new pin is in the loop/camp area.

WATERFRONT not waterfront kept: the Missouri here is a ~250 m channel (river, not creek). The loop's east side is ~40-60 m from the bank, but a continuous belt of riverbank trees stands between, broken only at the boat ramp and its approach (day use). The table sites west and south of the loop are ~80-150 m back in the trees. No open apron, and no official site photos to support a filtered riverview.
PHONE missing -> 402-468-5611 (2025 grid row 'Pelican Point SRA'; Parks_Locations; Google panel matches). apply.py does not write phones.

SITES count 6 and hookups electric 0 left as stored (derived from note prose): basic-only is confirmed by the grid, so electric 0 holds; NGPC's GIS site inventory does not map Pelican Point, so no count can be sourced (RV Life says 17).

NOTE: 'east of Tekamah' kept with the road (NGPC's address is 4699 County Road KL, Tekamah); 'park entry permit required' dropped as general to all NGPC areas. FLOOD: no closure seen on Google (no 'closed' marker; 4.8 from 5 reviews); NGPC's own alerts page is blocked, so a current flood closure could not be ruled out.
WEBSITE https://outdoornebraska.gov/location/pelican-point/ unread (domain blocked); Google links the same page. SAND: not applicable (gravel loop). FIT: open gravel loop, fine for 23 ft on imagery.
